themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and interact with systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often by suggesting code snippets or explanations.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, making information more digestible.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting job roles, recruitment, reskilling needs, and the overall nature of work.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of artificial user representations or data to simulate user behavior for testing or research.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Concerns the assessment, comparison, and review of various AI tools and platforms available in the market.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of testing the usability of products and systems.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers dedicated platforms designed to facilitate and accelerate scientific and academic research using AI capabilities.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems that create text, images, video, or other media content.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
